fieldValues.title: Instance generation is determined structurally
fieldValues.normative_statement: A reader MUST determine instance generation structurally. For a Tier-2 `Record`: an array `fieldValues` is revision <= 1, an object `fieldValues` is revision >= 2. For a Tier-1 `TypedRecord`: a `TypedField` carrying `fieldType` is revision >= 2, one without it is revision <= 1. On encountering a generation it does not support, a reader MUST emit a diagnostic naming the file and the expected `dataModelRevision` and MUST NOT coerce, partially read, or silently skip the document. (RFC-039 [R9])
